plugins.name: Markdown Preview
plugins.description: Rendered Markdown preview in a side panel with GFM tables, task lists, quotes and syntax-highlighted code blocks. Refreshes while you edit on Luban Notepad 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts show a plain-text preview.

versions.release_notes: Fit wide tables to the 640px preview panel: columns shrink and cells truncate instead of wrapping the box drawing.

Initial release. GFM headings, emphasis, links, images, lists, task lists, quotes, fenced and indented code, tables and rules. Code blocks use the host syntax theme via luban.syntax.highlight. The preview follows edits on 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts render the plain-text fallback and refresh manually.

zh-CN.name: Markdown 预览
zh-CN.description: 在右侧面板渲染 Markdown：支持 GFM 表格、任务列表、引用和语法高亮代码块。在 Luban Notepad 1.0.0-preview.2 及以上版本中随编辑自动刷新；旧版本显示纯文本预览。
